Designing and scaling frontend platforms or design systems used by multiple teams

rolesAndResponsibilities: Lead the design and evolution of our React-based platform architecture, serving as the technical anchor for one of the most demanding and highest-leverage projects in the company. Own frontend performance end to end: rendering strategy, bundle optimization, data-fetching patterns, and the observability to prove improvements with real-user metrics (Core Web Vitals, INP, TTI). Build and integrate AI-enabled features and infrastructure, including streaming LLM responses, real-time inference-driven UI, agentic workflows, and the state/data patterns that make AI experiences feel fast and reliable. Define and champion state management strategy across the platform, choosing the right tool for the job across Redux, Zustand, and RxJS-based reactive patterns, and guiding teams on when and how to use each. Evolve our build and developer-experience tooling on Vite, keeping local iteration fast and production builds lean as the codebase scales. Partner closely with Product and Design to translate UX intent into technical architecture, advocating for the user in technical decisions and for technical reality in product decisions. Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raise the bar through design reviews, and influence engineering direction beyond your immediate team. Make pragmatic build-vs-buy and prioritization decisions informed by business context, considering cost, time-to-market, customer impact, and long-term maintainability.

Desarrollar librerías de componentes reutilizables, accesibles y correctamente testeadas con React y TypeScript. Implementar interfaces de interacción en tiempo real con agentes, incluyendo la visualización progresiva de respuestas generadas por LLM. Consumir y visualizar resultados generados mediante IA, como respuestas RAG, análisis documental, trazas de razonamiento y métricas de evaluación. Implementar autenticación y control de acceso basado en roles mediante Azure Active Directory y MSAL. Participar en el despliegue de aplicaciones mediante Azure App Service y Azure Static Web Apps. Incorporar observabilidad y seguimiento de errores con Azure Monitor y Application Insights. Garantizar el rendimiento, la accesibilidad y la compatibilidad entre navegadores. Mantener la documentación de componentes mediante Storybook y contribuir a los estándares de desarrollo frontend. Participar en la definición de la arquitectura y las prácticas técnicas del nuevo hub desde sus primeras fases.

Collaboration: Work closely with product, design, and backend engineers to translate merchant needs into solid, user-friendly solutions.

Get the new platform into production: In your first few months, you’ll turn the architecture into shipped code, with the foundations for performance, reliability and observability in place. Lead senior engineers through the migration: Be the architectural anchor for Staff and Senior engineers across Mobile Platform, helping them navigate difficult technical decisions as the new platform takes shape. Scale adoption across Canva: In the new year, work with major product teams moving onto the platform, establishing patterns engineers trust and choose to use. Over time, you’ll become one of Canva’s technical voices on mobile architecture, with decisions influencing 800+ frontend engineers.
